summary: Unreal Hollows is the deepest distortion pocket of the Echoes of Existence. Here, false memories, unreal timelines, and conceptual beings manifest physically, forming a labyrinth of impossible caverns.
history: Formed when the Void absorbed unrealized timelines.
False memories condensed into physical caverns.
Creatures born of distortion emerged from the hollows.
The Unreal Sovereign arose as the ruler of unreal timelines.
